en: Black‑and‑white view along a riverside or lakeside road leading toward an ornate building with multiple towers and domes. The structure has a tall central tower, smaller cupolas, and step‑gabled façades, combining eclectic and Northern European architectural elements. In the foreground are simple wooden benches and railings beside the water. The image has the look of an old photographic postcard.
